Game Overview

At its heart, Christmas Girl Dressup is a dress up game about help a young girl sparkle this holiday season by crafting her dream Christmas outfit. Mix and match clothes, hairstyles, and accessories to create unique, festive styles. Enjoy endless combinations and find inspiration for your own holiday look in this creative and fun-filled dress-up experience for everyone.

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Christmas Girl Dressup is easy to pick up. Help a young girl sparkle this holiday season by crafting her dream Christmas outfit.
